title: Matrix character mismatch under translation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $q$ be any function from $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$ to $\mathbb F_2$, and let $A$ and $X$ be such matrices. For a uniformly random binary matrix $B$, the probability that $q(B+X)$ differs from the matrix character $C\mapsto\sum_{i,j}A_{ij}C_{ij}$ evaluated at $B+X$ equals the relative Hamming distance between $q$ and that character.
hypotheses_covered: A function $q$ from binary $n\times n$ matrices to $\mathbb F_2$
